## Checklist

- [ ] The folder was copied from `themes/theme_template`, and its `README.md` is deleted
- [ ] `metadata.ini` is filled in (name, author, version, description, kind)
- [ ] All 11 required files are present
- [ ] I tested it in the latest version of File Converter Pro: main window, Settings, Advanced Conversions, Template Manager and the Terms dialogs
- [ ] If I kept `splash.qss` and `window_card.qss`, I checked the splash screen and the Quick Convert window too
- [ ] `preview.png` is my own and the full screenshot is named `<Folder_Name>.png`
- [ ] For an update: I bumped `version` in `metadata.ini`
